query: What is the most recent NIFC National Fire News year-to-date acres burned figure for 2026, latest available as of late June 2026? Report the exact YTD acres and date.
answer:
I've completed the research. Here is the summary:

## Answer

The most recent NIFC National Fire News year-to-date figure available as of late June 2026 is from the **Incident Management Situation Report dated Tuesday, June 30, 2026 (0730 MDT)** — the final IMSR of the month:

- **YTD acres burned: 3,138,394 acres**
- **YTD wildfires: 35,884 fires**

**Key context:**
- The prior report (June 27, 2026) showed 2,951,605 YTD acres / 35,424 fires — so acres jumped ~187,000 (+6.3%) in the final days of June as the National Preparedness Level rose from PL 3 to PL 4.
- 2026 was running at **159% of the 10-year average** for acres (1,977,688) and **133%** for fires (27,042) as of June 30.
- Note: the live NIFC statistics webpage currently shows a higher figure (4,010,417 acres / 41,779 fires), but that reflects a *later* date (~mid/late July 2026), not late June. The correct late-June figure is the **3,138,394 acres** from the June 30 IMSR.

key_facts: Latest late-June 2026 NIFC YTD figure: 3,138,394 acres burned across 35,884 wildfires, per the IMSR dated Tuesday June 30, 2026 (0730 MDT) - the last IMSR of the month.
The June 27, 2026 IMSR reported an earlier late-June figure of 2,951,605 YTD acres and 35,424 YTD fires.
YTD acres rose ~186,789 (+6.3%) between June 27 and June 30, 2026, driven by Great Basin (UT/NV) and Rocky Mountain (CO) fires.
National Preparedness Level was raised from PL 3 (June 27) to PL 4 (June 30) during this window.
As of June 30, 2026, YTD acres were 159% of the 10-year (2016-2025) average of 1,977,688 acres; YTD fires were 133% of the 10-year average of 27,042 fires.
Rocky Mountain area led YTD acres at 1,297,880; Southern area second at 1,041,805 (June 30 IMSR).
Three firefighters (two USFS, one U.S. Wildland Fire Service) were killed June 28, 2026 on the Knowles Fire near Grand Junction, CO.
The live NIFC statistics webpage showed 4,010,417 acres / 41,779 fires, but that reflects a later date (~July 21-24, 2026), not late June.
